title: SCR Desk: single central record and safer-recruitment checks for small independent schools
summary: Every school in England must keep a Single Central Record (SCR) of safeguarding checks on staff, volunteers and, in independent schools, the proprietor body. Inspectors check it early, and errors are a common avoidable finding. SCR Desk collects the evidence, checks each entry and chases missing references and DBS checks.
hook: "The inspector opened our SCR in the first hour. Two references were missing dates and a governor's check wasn't recorded. That set the tone for two days."
story:
**Helen is the bursar of a 180-pupil independent prep school.** She keeps the Single Central Record in a large spreadsheet: identity, right to work, DBS, barred list, prohibition checks, overseas checks, qualifications and **section 128 checks for governors and managers**. Supply staff, coaches and peripatetic music teachers come and go every term.

Before the last inspection she spent **three evenings** checking every row against the paper files and found gaps: a reference with no date, a DBS update check not recorded. She wants a tool that stores the evidence with each check, shows red flags instantly and chases referees and staff automatically.
whyNow: Keeping Children Safe in Education is updated every September and inspectors (Ofsted and ISI) look at the SCR early in every inspection. Councils now sell "SCR health checks" to schools, which shows the need. AI can read DBS certificates, references and ID documents to fill entries and spot missing fields.
evidence: The SCR is described as one of the first things inspectors review and one of the most common sources of avoidable findings [MHR]
Independent schools must also record section 128 checks for management and checks on all members of the proprietor body [High Speed Training]
There is no set format; the SCR can be paper or electronic, so many schools use spreadsheets [High Speed Training]
Councils such as Worcestershire sell SCR health checks to schools [Worcestershire County Council]
SCR modules exist inside larger HR/MIS products (MHR, Access, iSAMS, Veracross) without public prices [vendor pages]
No published count of SCR failures was found; this must be validated with bursars [own research]

whyReal.title: Inspectors look first
whyReal.text: A weak SCR damages the whole safeguarding judgement, which is the most sensitive part of any school inspection.

whyReal.title: People change every term
whyReal.text: Supply staff, coaches, volunteers and contractors make the record go out of date quickly.

whyReal.title: Small schools have one person
whyReal.text: In a small independent school, the bursar or office manager does HR, finance and the SCR.

whyReal.title: Big HR suites are too much
whyReal.text: SCR modules usually come inside full HR or MIS systems that small schools don't want to switch.

whoPays.label: Customer

whoPays.label: Buyer
whoPays.text: bursar, head or designated safeguarding lead.

whoPays.label: Start market
whoPays.text: independent schools in England, then British international schools worldwide (they follow similar standards).

solution.title: Import the current SCR
solution.text: upload the spreadsheet; SCR Desk maps columns and flags empty or invalid fields.

solution.title: Attach evidence
solution.text: upload DBS certificates, IDs and references; AI fills dates and numbers and links the document.

solution.title: Check rules
solution.text: required checks by role (teacher, volunteer, governor, contractor) with red/amber/green status.

solution.title: Chase
solution.text: automatic emails to referees and new staff for missing documents.

solution.title: Inspection view
solution.text: a clean SCR export and an audit trail of who checked what and when.

must: Evidence upload with AI field extraction
later: Safer recruitment workflow (online searches, interview notes)

timeline.what: **Validate, no code.** Interview 12 bursars; audit one anonymised SCR by hand.
Import, rules, evidence upload and extraction.
Chase emails, dashboard, export, security review.
3 pilot schools before their next inspection window.
